name: Multiple Correspondence Analysis (MCA)
when_to_use: Three or more categorical variables simultaneously, when a single contingency table is not possible.

expected_input.question: What is the association structure among categorical variables?

plain_explanation.purpose: Makes the same map as correspondence analysis, but for several categorical variables at once.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are several multiple-choice questionnaires and you want to see which answers appear together.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with one respondent per row and several categorical columns (text or codes).
plain_explanation.example: See the answer profile of a satisfaction survey: whoever chooses 'excellent' also chooses what?
plain_explanation.diagram: answers to several questions -> single map: close answers appear together
